The 13-16s corridor walk is the only stretch where motion thins (mostly a gliding figure in static light); add environmental micro-motion (dust, bed shadows, light flicker) to keep the sub-beat alive.
Stitching close-up 19-22s is the rhythmic peak — match its beat density elsewhere by letting at least one element in every shot pulse or animate on a consistent tempo.
